import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
import planner
from gen2 import gen_case
import numpy as np
log = open('/workspace/tmp/tt2.log','w')
def p(*a):
    log.write(' '.join(str(x) for x in a)+'\n'); log.flush()
J,S,F,G,cap,tok,seed,span = 512,256,32,16,200,400,0,1000000000
p('start')

p('generated', case['model'], len(case['windows']))

n=len(case['windows'])
t0=time.time()
feats = np.array([w[7] for w in case['windows']], dtype=np.int64).reshape(n,9,2)
preds = __import__('testcnnonnx' if case['model']=='cnn' else 'testrnnonnx').evaluate_model_single_pass(feats, np.zeros(n,dtype=np.int64))
p('infer %.2f' % (time.time()-t0))

res = planner.solve_epoch(case)
p('plan %.2f' % (time.time()-t0), res['ratio'], sum(1 for a in res['assignment'] if a>=0))
